subject: Temporary telemetry relay partner onboarding: PulseStream (notice & evidence request)
messages:
From: Alice Thornton <alice@luminrelay.io>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Notice: temporary telemetry relay partner (PulseStream) onboarding
Attachments: pulsestream-processor-brief.pdf, pulsestream-soc2-summary.txt

Hi Rachel,

Quick heads-up from LuminRelay's ops team: we're onboarding a temporary telemetry relay provider, PulseStream (Ireland), to handle a short spike in telemetry ingestion for the next ~6 weeks while we scale our pipeline. This is a temporary integration (expected window: 2027-04-14 to 2027-05-26).

What they will process: anonymized telemetry and metrics (no PII or customer prompt text). Processing will be limited to metric/event payloads for routing and aggregation; no model payloads or logs of request content will be forwarded.

We've attached a one-page brief and a short SOC2 summary for PulseStream. High-level notes:
- Hosting/jurisdiction: Ireland (eu-west-1)
- Data types: pseudonymized telemetry only
- Access: scoped accounts for LuminRelay ops; logging forwarded to our observability stack
- Retention: 30 days max for transit buffering

Please confirm Redwood's intake needs (evidence, flows, DPA addendum?) and whether we should proceed with onboarding on our side. If anything here triggers a subprocessor notification from your side, flag it and we will coordinate.

Thanks,
Alice Thornton
Ops Lead, LuminRelay
alice@luminrelay.io

-----
Forwarded attachment stubs: pulsestream-processor-brief.pdf (1 page), pulsestream-soc2-summary.txt (summary, redacted)
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Alice Thornton <alice@luminrelay.io>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Notice: temporary telemetry relay partner (PulseStream) onboarding
Attachments: (none)

Alice — thanks for the heads-up and the brief. A few clarifying asks from our side so we can route this through security & legal intake: 

1) Confirm that no request/response payloads or model prompts will be forwarded to PulseStream. You mentioned "anonymized telemetry" but we need an explicit statement on content types (metrics, error codes, timestamps only).
2) KMS / key handling: where (jurisdiction) are any encryption keys held for the transit buffers? Is LuminRelay KMS in AWS eu-west-1 or does PulseStream manage keys?
3) Access controls: list of PulseStream ACL roles, admin breakout, and whether they support customer-scoped RBAC.
4) Evidence: full SOC 2 Type II report (or SOC 2 bridge report) would be ideal; if not available, provide the latest attestation and the specific control mapping for logging/retention.
5) Data flows: a sanitized dataflow diagram showing what leaves LuminRelay and lands on PulseStream, including egress destinations and any third hops.
6) DPA impact: confirm whether LuminRelay considers PulseStream a subprocessor under your DPA with Redwood (if yes, we will need the vendor roster entry and contact for signature of any DPA addendum).

If you can provide the evidence pack link and an ETA (48-72h preferred), we can triage this with Security and Legal. Kimberly — tagging you for KMS / controls assessment. Marissa — FYI in case procurement needs to review SLA/credits for an interim routing provider.

—Rachel
Rachel Kim
Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
From: Alice Thornton <alice@luminrelay.io>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: compliance@luminrelay.io, ops@pulsestream.io
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Notice: temporary telemetry relay partner (PulseStream) onboarding
Attachments: pulsestream-access-map.png

Hi Rachel,

Thanks for the quick reply — appreciate the checklist. Answers below and a link to the evidence bundle: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1a2b3cPulsestreamEvidencePack

1) Content: Confirmed — PulseStream will only handle metrics/event envelopes (metric name, value, timestamp, host id hash). No request/response body, no model prompts, and no customer content.
2) KMS: PulseStream uses customer-managed KMS keys in AWS eu-west-1 if requested; for this temporary routing we are using LuminRelay-managed keys (AWS KMS, eu-west-1). PulseStream has a KMS integration; keys are not exported.
3) Access: PulseStream supports scoped RBAC; only a service account for LuminRelay with narrow ACLs will be provisioned. Admin access is held by PulseStream security team (ops@pulsestream.io) and is audited.
4) Evidence: SOC2 summary attached and full attestation in the Drive link. We included the control mapping for logging, retention and access.
5) Data flows: sanitized PNG attached (pulsestream-access-map.png).
6) DPA/subprocessor: LuminRelay classifies PulseStream as a subprocessor. We have included the subprocessor contact (ops@pulsestream.io) and their public DPA/contract reference in the Drive pack.

ETA: can deliver the Drive pack fully within 24 hours. If Redwood needs a signed DPA addendum between Redwood and PulseStream (vs LuminRelay's contractual flow), please let us know and we will introduce the parties.

—Alice
Alice Thornton
Ops Lead, LuminRelay

-----
Forwarded: sanitized dataflow and access matrix (pulsestream-access-map.png). Drive evidence pack includes: Pulsestream SOC2 attestation (redacted), control matrix, staff ops list (redacted), network egress map.
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2027 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Notice: temporary telemetry relay partner (PulseStream) onboarding
Attachments: (none)

Rachel / Marissa — skimmed the Drive pack Alice sent. A few internal next steps I recommend: 

- Ask for the SOC2 Type II PDF (not just summary) and confirm date range covers 2026–2027. If they only have a bridge, get clarification on gaps.
- Obtain the sanitized dataflow in vector/PDF so Legal can annotate export hops. The PNG is fine for ops but Legal prefers a diagram they can mark.
- Confirm KMS ownership for the temporary window. If keys are LuminRelay-managed (as Alice said) we still need the explicit KMS key policy text for eu-west-1.
- Treat this as a subprocessor addition under our DPA; request LuminRelay to either attach a subprocessor roster entry (signed) or to introduce ops@pulsestream.io to Redwood Legal for a direct addendum if required by our DPA clauses.

Procurement (Marissa) — if Legal asks for an interim SLA/credit in case of missed delivery, you may need to coordinate a short-term concession.

I'll own the controls intake and will open a security ticket (SEC-2027-1189) and request the SOC2 artifacts. Rachel — please reply to Alice copying Legal@redwood.com and ask for the full PDFs plus a vector flow diagram.

—Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Director, Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
